President Sissé is exploring with the President of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development the possibility of contributing to the establishment of new investment zones in Egypt. Cairo appreciates the partnership that exists with the Bank's role in supporting development priorities.

reports.t: الرئيس السيسي يبحث مع رئيسة البنك الأوروبي لإعادة الإعمار والتنمية تعزيز الاستثمارات وتمويل المشروعات التنموية في مصر
reports.en: President Cissé is looking with the President of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development to promote investment and finance development projects in Egypt
